name: Jennea's Flask
summary: At the Wizard's Sanctum in Stormwind, Jennea Cannon sends apprentices to Mirror Lake for water. They bring the sample back for arcane analysis.

sections.title: A Vessel for Arcane Research
sections.body: After magical struggles across Azeroth, arcane currents have torn loose from their ancient channels. Jennea Cannon seeks to learn how these shifts have affected Elwynn Forest. She gives promising apprentices a glass flask and sends them southwest of Stormwind's gates to the base of Mirror Lake's waterfall. The flask protects the water sample on the journey back to the Wizard's Sanctum, where it can be examined for arcane disturbances.

sections.title: Guarding the Waters
sections.body: Jennea's flask lets Stormwind's mages check whether shifting ley lines have tainted Mirror Lake. If the water carries harmful magic, the surrounding life and anyone who drinks from it could suffer strange afflictions. A sample can reveal magical residue before tainted currents spread through the countryside.

faq.q: What is Jennea's Flask used for?
faq.answer: You use Jennea's Flask to gather water from the waterfall at Mirror Lake in Elwynn Forest.
Jennea Cannon, a mage trainer in Stormwind City's Wizard's Sanctum, gives you the flask.

faq.q: Why does Jennea want water from Mirror Lake?
faq.answer: Recent mystical conflicts have disrupted the flow of magic across the world. Jennea fears stray currents may be seeping into Elwynn's waters and endangering anyone who drinks from the lake.

faq.q: Where do you fill the flask?
faq.answer: Fill the flask at the base of the waterfall that flows into Mirror Lake, southwest of Stormwind's main gates in Elwynn Forest.

angles.text: As a mage, carrying this flask is one of your first field tasks for the Wizard's Sanctum. It tests your ability to handle delicate arcane research and watch for changes in ley lines.
